scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide-angle view of a city street with a large beige building in the background and a smaller beige building in the foreground. The street has a yellow barrier along its edge and a white car driving down it. A person wearing a blue jacket walks along the sidewalk in front of the smaller building. The sky is overcast.
scene_analysis.buildings: The larger building has a flat roof and a red banner hanging vertically on its side. It has many windows and a large arched doorway. The smaller building has a flat roof and a few windows. There are two people working near the entrance.
scene_analysis.materials: The larger building has a beige facade with stone quoins at the corners. The smaller building has a beige facade with a flat top.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are some small trees and bushes along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs on the buildings, including a large sign on the larger building.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: There are a few people walking along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The area appears to be quiet and peaceful.
scene_analysis.as_student: The area is quiet and peaceful.
